description: Precompile inputs that must give 0 (expect 0) or revert (input over MAX_INPUT, P6f): each is the honest input u8(op) || be32(len) || stmt || proof of (form, id) (statements: statement_*.json under the id; proofs: proof_<id>.json) with edits applied in order: op = the op byte; proof_from = another form's proof (same id); stmt_set / proof_set [offset, hex] overwrite; proof_copy [src, dst, len], proof_swap [a, b, len] move bytes; stmt_resize / proof_resize truncate or zero-extend; stmt_flip / proof_flip [byte, bit]; len_field replaces be32(len); raw = the whole input; input_resize truncates or zero-extends the built input. input_sha3 = SHA3-256 of the input (FIPS 202, not Keccak: Python checks it fast). reason: the pqz-stmt decoder's Reject (D5, D15, R6), or verify (the decoder accepts and the verifier of the id rejects: PQZL specialised and generic agree). Expected outputs from pqz_precompile (C ABI). openings: the disclosure opening abi.encode(bytes bundle, bytes proof) (TRANSFER bundle, PQZL DISCLOSE-SENDER proof) with set [offset, hex] / resize edits, and pqz-stmt parse_opening's result (ok or Opening).
